cards.front: Defiance can reinforce the power it seeks to dismantle, creating a vicious cycle of control and resistance/[...].
cards.back:

cards.back: • Contrary to the notion that individual acts of defiance weaken the regime, Orwell argues that these acts are manipulated to reinforce the Party's control.
